package calc

// Probe of card 'clamp-value', written by morph plan --write-probes: one test per example of its Functions.
// Write each body from its example; until you do, it fails.

func TestProbeClampValueExample1(t *testing.T) {
	// given: v 5, lo 0, hi 3
	// when: clamped
	// then: 3
	t.Fatal("probe clamp-value: write Clamp Value example 1")
}

func TestProbeClampValueExample2(t *testing.T) {
	// given: v -2, lo -1, hi 4
	// when: clamped
	// then: -1
	t.Fatal("probe clamp-value: write Clamp Value example 2")
}

func TestProbeClampValueExample3(t *testing.T) {
	// given: v 7, lo 9, hi 2
	// when: clamped
	// then: 7 — the bounds are swapped to 2..9
	t.Fatal("probe clamp-value: write Clamp Value example 3")
}

func TestProbeClampValueExample4(t *testing.T) {
	// given: v 12, lo 9, hi 2

	// then: 9
	t.Fatal("probe clamp-value: write Clamp Value example 4")
